name: Commune by The Great Wall

address.street: The Great Wall Exit No 53 Shuiguan G6 Jingzang Highway Beijing

insider_take: This isn't just a hotel—it's an architectural pilgrimage site where 12 of Asia's most visionary architects created stunning villas scattered across a pristine valley near the Great Wall.
whats_special: Each of the 12 villas represents a different architectural vision, from Kengo Kuma's bamboo-clad Bamboo Wall to Shigeru Ban's innovative Furniture House. The property sits in the Shuiguan section of the Great Wall, offering exclusive access to less crowded stretches of this UNESCO World Heritage site. Several villas have been featured in the Venice Architecture Biennale, making this a living museum of contemporary Asian design.
pro_tip: Book the Red Capital Club villa for the most dramatic views, or choose SOHO China's Split House for its infinity pool that appears to merge with the mountain landscape.
dont_miss: The private sunrise hike to the Great Wall's Shuiguan section starts right from the property—you'll often have this ancient wonder entirely to yourself. The on-site contemporary art collection features rotating exhibitions, and the spa treatments incorporate traditional Chinese medicine with views of the wall through floor-to-ceiling windows.
pros: Unique architectural experience with 12 contemporary villas designed by Asian architects
Exclusive location adjacent to the Great Wall of China with breathtaking views
Tranquil mountain setting offering peaceful retreat from city life
Award-winning design concept blending modern luxury with natural landscape
cons: Remote location requires longer travel time from Beijing city center
Limited dining and entertainment options due to secluded mountain setting
